notes: πρωτοκλισίας → *chief seats* is headed on *seats* under rule 66's compound clause, κλισία being the core and πρωτο- the modifying element; heading on *chief* would put the head on the modifier.
τοὺς κεκλημένους splits under rule 32 because the ASV writes two words: *those* to the article and *that were bidden* to the participle.
